description: Read the result of a secure eligibility check started with start_eligibility_check. Pass the sessionId returned by that tool. Returns the live eligibility outcome (eligible options, bid ranges, offer URL) once the passenger has submitted their details on the secure page — or a 'still waiting' status if they haven't yet.

conversationId.description: Optional stable conversation id — lets later tools (place_bid) reuse this booking without re-passing the sessionId.

name: get_eligibility_result
